answer: You bought an Instant Pot before getting the Air Fryer.
notes:
User is meal-prepping healthy lunches and recently bought an Instant Pot and Air Fryer. Interested in Korean Chicken Stew (Jjimdak), using boneless skinless chicken, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic, gochujang, soy sauce, gochugaru, brown sugar, black pepper, broth, sesame oil, and optional green onions; cook at high pressure, season afterward, and serve with rice/noodles or kimchi. New to gochujang and sensitive to heat: reduce gochugaru from 2 to 1 tablespoon and adjust to taste. Chicken breast can replace thighs/drumsticks, cut into 1–2-inch pieces; reduce pressure-cooking time to about 10–12 minutes and verify 165°F/74°C. Thighs or mixed cuts may be more tender.

For bean/lentil meals, user enjoyed recent chili con carne and chose a Cuban Black Bean and Rice Bowl. Planned sides: Air Fryer sweet potato fries and a simple fresh fruit salad with lime and optional mint. Fries: use thin, uniform sweet potato strips, preferably starchy Russet/Idaho; soak 30 minutes, dry thoroughly, lightly oil, air-fry at 400°F/200°C for 12–15 minutes, shaking halfway, without overcrowding; season after cooking.

Leftover bowl: refrigerate in shallow airtight containers within 2 hours, use within 3–5
